content: Healthcare professionals are advised to assess social determinants of health that may impact youth with type 2 diabetes. These include evaluating for food insecurity, housing instability, limited health literacy, financial challenges, and the availability of community support. These factors should be integrated into the overall diabetes management plan for the patient. Healthcare providers should utilize age-appropriate and validated screening tools to identify diabetes-related emotional distress, symptoms of depression, and disordered eating behaviors in youth with type 2 diabetes. When necessary, patients should be referred to behavioral health specialists for further evaluation and intervention. Preconception counseling should be offered to all individuals with diabetes who are of childbearing potential. This counseling aims to optimize pregnancy outcomes by addressing diabetes management and related health considerations prior to conception. Adolescents and young adults diagnosed with diabetes should be screened for substance use, including the use of tobacco, nicotine products, alcohol, and other drugs. This screening should occur at the time of diagnosis and be repeated periodically during follow-up care.
